evidence_review.method: Independently read exact NRS 484D.205(4) text in the assignment and all four frozen accepted metadata records. Compare their stated Native velocity/heading and lamp API observations for forward on/off, reverse on and stationary on. Treat expected labels as review context, not new physical or legal proof. The statute does not specify a transition grace interval; do not infer one from the summary. No additional recording is needed for the selected forward-motion prohibition and its applicability contrasts on these source-backed accepted records.
